name: Memories and Childhood
blurb: Kỷ niệm, tuổi thơ, hoài niệm

words.meaningVi: nỗi nhớ da diết về quá khứ
words.definitionEn: a sentimental longing or wistful affection for a period in the past
words.example: The old photograph filled her with a deep sense of nostalgia for her carefree childhood.

words.meaningVi: hồi ức, kỷ niệm đã qua
words.definitionEn: a story or account of a past event or experience that is remembered
words.example: His reminiscences of summer holidays at the beach were vivid and heartwarming.

words.definitionEn: the action or faculty of remembering something; a memory
words.example: Her recollection of the school's annual fair was surprisingly detailed.

words.definitionEn: producing powerful feelings or strong, clear images in the mind
words.example: He has a vivid memory of the first time he rode a bicycle without training wheels.

words.definitionEn: to keep a memory or feeling in your mind because it is valuable or important
words.example: I will always cherish the moments I spent playing with my grandparents.

words.definitionEn: the early stage of childhood, especially the first year of life
words.example: The experiences during infancy can have a profound impact on a person's emotional development.

words.meaningVi: sự nuôi dạy, giáo dục từ nhỏ
words.definitionEn: the way in which a child is raised and educated
words.example: A strict upbringing often shapes a child's sense of discipline and responsibility.

words.meaningVi: hình thành, có ảnh hưởng lớn (thời kỳ phát triển)
words.definitionEn: relating to the period of someone's life that has a strong influence on their character
words.example: The formative years of childhood are crucial for developing social skills.

words.meaningVi: cột mốc quan trọng (trong cuộc đời)
words.definitionEn: an important event or stage in the development of something
words.example: Learning to walk is a major milestone in a child's physical development.

words.meaningVi: hồi tưởng đột ngột, ký ức ùa về
words.definitionEn: a sudden, clear memory of a past event that seems real
words.example: The smell of freshly baked bread triggered a flashback to her grandmother's kitchen.

words.definitionEn: an object kept as a reminder of a person, place, or event
words.example: She kept the seashell as a memento of their family trip to the coast.

words.definitionEn: a small item that is kept in memory of the person who gave it or the event it is associated with
words.example: The locket was a precious keepsake from her late mother.

words.meaningVi: ngây thơ, trong trắng (thời thơ ấu)
words.definitionEn: free from moral wrong; not corrupted or guilty
words.example: The innocent games of childhood often involve simple imagination and creativity.

words.meaningVi: vô tư lự, không lo âu
words.definitionEn: free from anxiety or responsibility
words.example: Those carefree days of summer vacation are among my most cherished memories.

words.definitionEn: having affection or liking for someone or something
words.example: I have fond memories of reading bedtime stories with my father.

words.definitionEn: far away in time or space
words.example: The distant past of early childhood often feels like another world.

words.definitionEn: to remember something from the past
words.example: Many adults can clearly recall their first day at school.

words.definitionEn: to become unclear or difficult to see or remember
words.example: As time passes, the details of childhood incidents often blur together.

words.definitionEn: to gradually become less clear or less bright
words.example: Memories of early childhood tend to fade unless they are frequently revisited.

words.meaningVi: đa cảm, dễ xúc động về kỷ niệm
words.definitionEn: based on or influenced by feelings of tenderness, sadness, or nostalgia
words.example: She became sentimental when she found her old toy box in the attic.

words.meaningVi: niềm khao khát, mong mỏi về quá khứ
words.definitionEn: a strong feeling of wishing for something, especially something that you have lost or cannot have
words.example: The old song evoked a deep yearning for the simplicity of childhood.

words.definitionEn: to bring a memory, feeling, or image into the mind
words.example: The scent of freshly cut grass can evoke memories of playing in the garden as a child.

words.definitionEn: to remember and show respect for a past event or person
words.example: They built a small statue to commemorate the happy days of their shared childhood.

words.meaningVi: đầy xúc động, sâu sắc (gây thương nhớ)
words.definitionEn: evoking a keen sense of sadness or regret, often related to memories
words.example: The photograph of her childhood home was a poignant reminder of the time that had passed.

words.meaningVi: khó nắm bắt, khó nhớ rõ (ký ức)
words.definitionEn: difficult to find, catch, or achieve; often used to describe memories that are hard to recall
words.example: The details of her earliest memory remain elusive, no matter how hard she tries to remember.

words.definitionEn: the period of time when you are a child
words.example: My childhood was filled with joyful moments.

words.definitionEn: something that you remember
words.example: One of my earliest memories is playing in the garden.

words.definitionEn: the time before the present
words.example: Dwelling on the past can prevent personal growth.

words.definitionEn: something that happens to you that affects you
words.example: My experience of moving to a new city shaped my personality.

words.definitionEn: an idea, feeling, or opinion about something
words.example: The first impression of a place can stay with you forever.

words.definitionEn: the power to affect how someone or something develops
words.example: My parents' influence on my childhood was profound.

words.definitionEn: a length of time
words.example: The early period of my life was spent in a small town.

words.definitionEn: a stage in a process of change or development
words.example: Adolescence is a challenging phase for many people.

words.definitionEn: a custom or belief passed down over time
words.example: Our family tradition of Sunday dinners is a cherished memory.

words.definitionEn: something that is handed down from the past
words.example: The legacy of my grandparents' hard work still inspires me.

words.definitionEn: the traditions, achievements, and beliefs that are part of a group's history
words.example: Exploring my cultural heritage helped me understand my roots.

words.definitionEn: a person's family line of descent
words.example: I traced my ancestry back to the 18th century.

words.definitionEn: the origin or background of a person or thing
words.example: My immigrant parents instilled in me a sense of my roots.

words.definitionEn: worth remembering
words.example: My first trip abroad was a memorable experience.

words.definitionEn: important and meaningful
words.example: That event was significant in shaping my childhood.

words.definitionEn: very great or intense
words.example: The loss of a pet can have a profound impact on a child.

words.definitionEn: lasting over a long period
words.example: Some childhood memories are enduring.

words.definitionEn: easily influenced
words.example: Children are impressionable at a young age.

words.definitionEn: thinking deeply about the past
words.example: The old photograph made me feel reflective.

words.definitionEn: to fix firmly in the mind
words.example: My early years imprinted a love of nature in me.

words.definitionEn: to mention something that happened in the past
words.example: The old house harks back to a simpler time.

words.definitionEn: to experience again in the mind
words.example: I often relive the happy moments of my childhood.

words.definitionEn: to think carefully about the past
words.example: I often reflect on my childhood memories.

words.definitionEn: thinking about past events
words.example: In retrospect, I realize how important my childhood was.

words.definitionEn: to keep something valuable in your memory
words.example: I treasure the time I spent with my grandparents.
